About Juicer

Deposit a single asset. Juicer manages borrowing and converts strategy yield back into your deposited asset.

1

Deposit

Your deposit supplies collateral and creates position shares. Juicer then builds the leveraged strategy gradually.

Depositing does not make a swap. Keepers deploy pooled collateral as market conditions allow.

2

Earn

Harvested yield is converted into your deposited asset after costs and fees. Funded earnings stay invested and are included in your balance.

There is nothing to claim. Yield that is not harvested yet shows separately as pending yield.

3

Withdraw

Request a full or partial withdrawal. Your shares stay invested during the cooldown, then settle into your deposited asset.

The cooldown is the earliest unwind start, not a payout deadline.

Returns are variable. The leveraged strategy can lose value or be liquidated, and withdrawals may be delayed. Principal and immediate repayment are not guaranteed.
